question:
In the following question, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11cedc499df2f25ad0542be83615b21e6f25d20215faa9907f4f12473281542b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Numbers decrease by 5, 6, 7, and 8.
 
• Figure's side decrease by 1 in next figure and gets darkened alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fd4448a7e7616a8783ea4c3136cc3831dfd0389fc0c389e4fdee2fa16e37ee4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
